import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-apply-leave', templateUrl: './apply-leave.component.html', styleUrls: ['./apply-leave.component.css'] }) export class ApplyLeaveComponent { employeeId: number = 1; // Default Employee ID (Can be changed dynamically) leaveType: string = ''; // Leave Type input startDate: string = ''; // Start Date input endDate: string = ''; // End Date input status: string = 'Pending'; // ✅ Fix: Define 'status' with default 'Pending' applyLeave() { console.log("Leave Application Submitted:", { employeeId: this.employeeId, leaveType: this.leaveType, startDate: this.startDate, endDate: this.endDate, status: this.status }); } }
